opportunities.title: WotC's Big Keynote: Here's the One Rule Change That'll Actually Matter (Spoiler: Probably None)
opportunities.why_now: The D&D keynote livestream is happening today, giving a same-day reaction window before the hype cycle dies.
opportunities.angle: Short reaction video posted live/day-of predicting which announced mechanic will actually see table use vs. marketing filler — deliver as a cynical veteran-GM prediction list.

opportunities.title: WotC Just Lost Its President — Your Campaign Doesn't Care, Here's Why
opportunities.why_now: John Hight's abrupt departure is fresh industry news and ripe for a no-fluff take on why corporate churn at WotC never actually changes what happens at your table.
opportunities.angle: Dry monologue tying executive turnover to the reality that rules-as-written don't change with leadership — pivot into a concrete ruling example to keep it on-beat.

opportunities.title: Jungle King Magic Items Are Broken in the Right Way — Here's the Actual Use-Case
opportunities.why_now: EN World's fresh wilderness magic item roundup gives concrete new items to mechanically stress-test before players find the article themselves.
opportunities.angle: Pick one specific jungle/wilderness item from the piece, run the numbers on an optimal use-case at a specific level, deliver as a 60-second spell/item breakdown.

opportunities.title: Doll-Type Monsters Are Just Constructs With Better PR — Tactics for Running Them
opportunities.why_now: RPG Evolution's 'Valley of the Dolls' piece is timely enough to ride the doll-horror trend into a concrete creature tactic breakdown.
opportunities.angle: Take a specific doll/construct statblock (flesh golem, animated armor reflavor) and give one nasty tactic GMs should be running against players, Shadowdark and 5e versions side by side.

opportunities.title: The 'Lazy GM' Method Is Just Prep You're Already Doing Wrong — Here's the Fix
opportunities.why_now: Gnomecast's fresh episode with Mike Shea on the Lazy GM approach gives a hook to translate a popular prep philosophy into one hard ruling/technique.
opportunities.angle: Distill one specific Lazy GM technique (e.g., secret monster HP tracking or strong-start improv) into a single mechanical tip delivered in the channel's terse veteran-GM style.
